ns2:section.sectionText: Course is second 8 weeks. Starts on 10/17/2022 and ends on 12/7/2022, plus final exams. Additional details will be available in the syllabus. Reach out to the instructor for any questions. In this course you will work with original Italian short texts that talk about women: literary texts, advertisement, film and TV. The goal is to enhance your ability to understand, speak and write Italian by extensively practicing the main structural categories and their uses in texts carefully selected to be grammatically pertinent and culturally insightful. You will complete daily exercises analyzing grammatical transformations and will create your own oral and written stories, while learning how are women represented in Italian narratives.
